questions.stem:
SCIENCE MATERIAL SET 3
Students tested how water temperature affected the time required for a tablet to dissolve. They used identical tablets, 102 mL of water in each cup, and stirred each cup at the same rate.

TABLE 1
Temperature (°C) | Dissolving time (s)
10 | 31
20 | 23
30 | 18
40 | 14

Trial 2 repeated the procedure with twice the water volume. Researcher 1 claims that higher temperature increases particle motion and therefore decreases dissolving time. Researcher 2 agrees that temperature matters but claims that stirring rate is the dominant factor whenever stirring is not controlled.

Which modification would best improve reliability?
A) Repeat every condition and average the times.
B) Use a different tablet in every condition.
C) Stop recording dissolving time.
D) Change temperature and stirring rate together.

options.A: Repeat every condition and average the times.
options.B: Use a different tablet in every condition.
options.C: Stop recording dissolving time.
options.D: Change temperature and stirring rate together.

questions.explanation: The keyed response follows the material and directly targets 选择提高可靠性或效度的修改.
